purpose: Define which sensor-depth samples may supervise or evaluate MHR surface fitting without confusing a foreground mask with bare skin.
observation_source: HuMMan Kinect sensor depth transformed with released calibration; fitted SMPL parameters are excluded as observation truth.

released_mask_semantics.known: The official release calls these masks computed with background. They are used here only as person/foreground support.

classes.name: VALID_BODY_SURFACE
classes.definition: A depth sample on the visible person surface, away from unreliable boundaries, with valid metric depth and consistent calibration.
classes.claim: body/person surface alignment only unless separately proven to be bare skin

classes.name: CLOTHING_SURFACE
classes.definition: Visible clothing measured by the depth sensor, including tight or loose garments.
classes.claim: clothed surface alignment; never skin or anatomical surface accuracy
classes.qualification: Very loose, flapping or topology-changing garments may be excluded during visual QA and recorded as a failure/exclusion reason.

classes.name: SCENE_OBJECT
classes.definition: Floor, wall, furniture, equipment or another non-person object.

classes.name: BED_CONTACT
classes.definition: Support-surface depth at or immediately adjacent to a body/support contact zone where ownership is ambiguous.
classes.note: HuMMan candidates may use floor/support rather than a bed. The same exclusion applies.

classes.name: SELF_OCCLUDED
classes.definition: An anatomical surface not directly observed by the scoring camera, including surfaces hidden by another body part.

classes.name: UNKNOWN
classes.definition: A sample whose ownership, calibration, depth reliability or semantics cannot be established.

automatic_validity_pipeline.rule: Read raw uint16 depth without normalization; remove raw value 0 and values outside the frozen working-depth interval.
Unproject in the depth camera and transform/project into the corresponding color camera using PUBLIC_RGBD_GEOMETRY_CONTRACT_V1.
Require support from the released person/foreground mask after its coordinate frame has been verified.
Erode the person mask and exclude a depth-discontinuity band so flying pixels and mixed foreground/background samples cannot enter fitting or scoring.
Apply an independent depth-consistency/normal-quality check; invalid, isolated and multipath-like samples become UNKNOWN.

For cross-view evaluation, keep only Camera-B samples visible from Camera B. Mutual visibility with Camera A is not required for held-out scoring, but Camera-A data must never enter the Camera-B metric.

checks: person mask follows the person rather than scene/background
torso/back visibility is sufficient for the intended comparison
hair does not enter torso/back scoring
Camera A and Camera B show genuinely independent geometry
registration overlays have no gross edge offset
manual_visual_qa.annotation_source: RGB, raw depth, registered depth and released person mask only; do not display SAM/MHR overlays while deciding observation validity.

held_out_view_policy.independence: No Camera-B depth point, silhouette, mask-derived loss, normal, metric or tuned residual may enter optimization or early stopping.

required_counts: points removed by boundary/depth validity filters
reporting.statistical_unit: subject; dense pixels are samples within a subject and must not be counted as independent subjects

known_limitations: The release mask does not separate clothing from skin.
The five candidates have not yet passed actual-frame visual QA.
No public selected observation is yet confirmed to be an exposed prone back.
Contact and self-occlusion labels are inferred conservatively during QA rather than supplied as authoritative dataset classes.
failure_policy: When a sample cannot be assigned safely, label it UNKNOWN and exclude it. If too little valid independent Camera-B surface remains, exclude the frame/sequence or return INCONCLUSIVE_DATA_OR_OPTIMIZATION_LIMITED.

mask_finding_after_extraction.use: apply before unprojection; then transform selected person points into color camera
